newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan buys 72,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat at tender.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys 72,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat at tender.

text.p: The Taiwan Flour Mills Association on Wednesday bought two shipments of U.S. wheat totalling 72,000 tonnes, traders said.
Each shipment contains Dark Northern Spring (DNS), Hard Red Winter (HRW) and White Wheat (WW), and all are slated for delivery from the Pacific Northwest, traders said.

The milling association is placing the tender on behalf of several major Taiwan wheat buying companies -- including President Enterprises Corp, Tai Yu Products, Chia Hsin Food, Formosa Oilseed and Lien Hwa Industrial Corp as well as other wheat millers.
